args: const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');const dst=path.join('.claude','skills');fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});let n=0;for(const base of [path.join('.agents','skills'),path.join('.agents','skills','vendor')]){if(!fs.existsSync(base))continue;for(const d of fs.readdirSync(base,{withFileTypes:true})){const src=path.join(base,d.name);if(d.isDirectory()&&fs.existsSync(path.join(src,'SKILL.md'))){fs.cpSync(src,path.join(dst,d.name),{recursive:true});n++}}}console.log(n+' skills copiadas a .claude/skills')
